name: spoiler-text

frames.best_why: One spoiler is clearing into readable text while the second is still a speckled patch.

tagline: Hidden phrases sit under shimmering static that scatters away when clicked.
summary: Inline hidden text covered by a drifting field of speckles, shown inside a small group chat. Clicking or focusing a patch throws the specks outward and fades the words into view, and Hide again restores them.
appearance: A dark chat panel headed # the-finale holds three messages, each with a round initial avatar, name, time and a short paragraph. Two phrases are replaced by dense rectangular patches of pale speckles; revealed phrases show normal text on a faint grey highlight, with a Hide again link at top right.
behaviour: While hidden, the specks twinkle and drift inside each phrase's box. Clicking a patch, or focusing it and pressing Enter, sends a wave from that point that blows the specks outward as they fade, letting the blurred words sharpen, while Hide again re-covers both phrases.
demo_content: A chat about a TV finale where Maya, Jun and You mention the lighthouse keeper and someone not making it off the island.
search_phrases: click to reveal hidden text inline
speckled blur that clears on click
tv show spoiler cover in a chat
reveal text with a particle wave
use_when: A conversation or article must hide a plot point behind a deliberate click.
avoid_when: Very long passages: the speck canvas follows every text box and each patch reveals on its own.
customise: The hidden words are children, with controlled or default revealed state, a screen-reader label and a change callback as props; speck density and wave timing are constants.
weight_why: Up to 2400 canvas specks animate continuously while any spoiler stays hidden.

a11y.note: A hidden patch is a labelled button revealed by Enter or Space, hidden text is aria-hidden, and reduced motion stops the drift.

issues: Mid-reveal the scattering specks sit over the words, briefly making them hard to read.
polish_why: Neat speckle reveal with a satisfying particle wave; the patch does not look obviously clickable.
title: Spoiler Text
